title: Stilt mandatory for plots above 100 up to 750 sqm (MPD-2047 Other controls for Plotted Housing (vi))

citations.original_text: (vi) Provision of stilt shall be mandatory for plots with area above 100 sqm up to 750 sqm.

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.177, the first sentence of Other controls (vi); the sentence after it ('For plots above 750 sqm area, parking may be provided in the setback/stilt…') makes stilt optional above 750 sqm and is not encoded. 'Above 100 sqm up to 750 sqm' maps to the engine's exclusive-inclusive between [100, 750]. Until now this requirement lived only as a caveat on the FAR rules (mpd2047.res_plotted.far.100_250, .250_750) with no citation of its own, so the tool could state it but not open its source. effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E).
